pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, blotch-like patches with soft, low-contrast edge gradients. Geometry varies from sub-polygonal on the upper flank to smaller, more fragmented circularity on the hindlimbs and ventral surface.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected system of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes consist of multi-directional intersections. The pixel width of the corridors is relatively wide and stable across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated contour along the neck's dorsal ridge. The mane presents a high-frequency silhouette of individual hair tufts against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject perched on the upper neck region of the dorsal ridge.
